# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 16 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the night value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | night | parchment | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #192851 | #e6cb9c | Page ground. Night: the navy sky behind Hero → Timeline. Parchment: print, docs and light pages. |
| `surface-deep` | #0f1922 | #d9b983 | Deepest ground: the vignette at the emblem's centre, marquee band, footer. |
| `surface-raised` | #213263 | #f1dfbb | Raised panels and demo cards on surface. Night value derived (not sampled). |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the night value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | night | parchment | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #e0d69a | #192851 | Headings and display type (Thai + Latin) on surface, surface-deep and surface-raised — ≥9:1 in both themes. |
| `ink-body` | #dfe4f2 | #2b2418 | Body paragraphs on surface and surface-raised (≥9.7:1). |
| `ink-muted` | #b9c2d9 | #5a4a2e | Captions, metadata and descriptions on surface and surface-raised (≥5.4:1). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--line);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the night value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (16)

| token | night | parchment | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | rgba(224, 214, 154, 0.35) | rgba(25, 40, 81, 0.3) | Decorative hairlines and card outlines only — never the sole border of a control. |
| `accent` | #f0d590 | #192851 | Primary action fill (Button primary), selected MajorTile ring, active DiamondDots. |
| `focus` | #fef0ba | #192851 | Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px; ≥9:1 on every surface. |
| `navy` | #192851 | #192851 | Brand navy (sampled from the site). Night sky ground; ink on parchment. |
| `navy-ink` | #0f1922 | #0f1922 | Darkest navy (sampled), vignettes and glow cores. |
| `champagne` | #e0d69a | #e0d69a | Champagne gold (sampled): all heading text on navy. |
| `gold-solid` | #f0d590 | #f0d590 | Solid gold (sampled): the bright end of the MajorTile gradient, tracked labels. |
| `logo-gold` | #f6e18b | #f6e18b | Main fill of the logo's W, 21 and zodiac ring (sampled from the logo PNG). |
| `gold-highlight` | #fef0ba | #fef0ba | Specular highlight on the logo's gold bevel; the brightest gold. |
| `gold-shadow` | #a29459 | #a29459 | Shaded side of the logo's gold bevel. Decorative only — 4.7:1 on navy, not for body text. |
| `compass-slate` | #415d67 | #415d67 | Stroke of the compass-star inside the logo ring. Decorative line colour; 4.5:1 on parchment. |
| `celestial-blue` | #4686d2 | #4686d2 | The blue halo behind the glow logo. Glow and atmosphere only (3.8:1 on navy — never text). |
| `parchment` | #e6cb9c | #e6cb9c | Parchment (sampled): torn-edge cards, the Timeline box, map/cloud shapes. |
| `white` | #ffffff | #ffffff | Decorative circles in the YWC21 intro section. |
| `placeholder-gray` | #464646 | #464646 | Builder placeholder in the unfinished sections (Location, Q&A, Sponsors, Footer). NOT a design colour — do not ship. |
| `media-gray` | #cacaca | #cacaca | Empty image slot in Gallery before real photos. Placeholder only. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-hero-th);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-wordmark);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hero-th` | `.hero-th`, `--text-hero-th` | 48px / 60px | 400 | `thai-display` | Hero line and page titles, Thai. Colour ink. |
| `section-th` | `.section-th`, `--text-section-th` | 28px / 40px | 400 | `thai-display` | Every section title (ทำไมต้อง YWC21, ภาพกิจกรรม, สาขาในค่าย, Timeline). |
| `card-th` | `.card-th`, `--text-card-th` | 20px / 30px | 400 | `thai-display` | Titles inside ParchmentCard and MajorTile. |
| `numeral` | `.numeral`, `--text-numeral` | 64px / 64px | 700 | `latin-display` | “YWC 21”, the number 21, big stats and dates. |
| `wordmark` | `.wordmark`, `--text-wordmark` | 20px / 22px | 600 | `wordmark` | The camp name in caps when set as text beside the mark. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `sans` | Uppercase English label under a Thai title. Colour gold-solid on night. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 30px | 400 | `sans` | Intro paragraphs. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Default body, Thai and English mixed. Colour ink-body. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Captions and metadata. Colour ink-muted. |
| `button` | `.button`, `--text-button` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Button labels. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wordmark` | `--font-wordmark` | `"Oswald", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif` |
| `latin-display` | `--font-latin-display` | `"Playfair Display", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif` |
| `thai-display` | `--font-thai-display` | `"Chonburi", "Trirong", serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Prompt", "Noto Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-text gap, dot gaps. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Heading → English label (tight). |
| `space-3` | 12px | Inside tags and small controls. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Mobile page gutter; card inner padding. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Card padding; gap between parchment cards on mobile. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Section heading → content. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Gap between cards on desktop (≈⅓ card width). |
| `space-22` | 88px | Section rhythm — the generous breath between sections. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-xs) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-xs` | 2px | MajorTile, media slots — the site is nearly square. |
| `radius-sm` | 4px | Buttons, callouts, inputs. |
| `radius-md` | 6px | Panels on surface-raised. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Emblem discs and round badges. |
